country_decisions: country.tax.registration: taxpayer categories, registration identifiers, tax obligations and registration procedures (approved by the authorized tax and legal authority).
Registration thresholds and obligation triggers: an approved rule per tax (lib/law/rules.ts); none ships.
country.tax.return_schemas: tax types in force, filing schemas, periods, calculation rules and declaration wording.
country.exec.finance.retention: retention, confidentiality, disclosure and access restrictions for these records (records owner and legal and privacy reviewers).

library.title: Register for an additional tax obligation
library.intro: Register an existing taxpayer for another tax obligation, from the date the law sets. Which obligations exist, and when one must be registered, is the nation's law.
library.filled_by: The taxpayer or someone authorised to act for them.
library.authority: The tax administration the nation names under Who is responsible (deployment profile slot tax, authorityFor('tax')); where tax policy and tax administration are different institutions, only the administration acts on these forms; never a ministry by name.
library.intended: An obligation step of the registration amendment procedure (adding a tax type to the taxpayer's record): not built; the form waits in the library (plan step I5).

policies.access.read_rule: canReadTax() in lib/auth/roles.ts: the tax authority's officials and auditors with a purpose; every read in the access log
policies.access.others: Other institutions learn only registration status, through the taxpayer.status exchange service, for an approved purpose

nation_values.decision: Who must or may register for each tax and from when: the registration thresholds and obligation triggers of each tax.
The time within which a person must register after an obligation arises.
When an added, cancelled, suspended or reactivated obligation takes effect (for example from the event, the next period or the decision).

deviations.what: The tax register keeps the history of what decided cases did, but no procedure yet changes a registration's details, obligations, responsible office or state, so this form waits in the library; the register will keep every version when it is built
deviations.why: The specification's registration amendment (change request, evidence, validation, approval; an updated account version) is a procedure of its own; none was invented here.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: registers change only through procedure effects; plan step I5

deviations.what: Representation is asked as the form's own fields (taxpayer.acting_through_representative, taxpayer.representative_capacity, taxpayer.representative, taxpayer.authority_evidence; the ids of the catalogue's business registration contract, with the capacities of civicos.representation.capacity.v1), not through the field group core.representation, whose fields carry personal and administrative classes
deviations.why: A form uses a field group by id and version and never changes its fields (Part 1 §1.1); who represents a taxpayer is under tax secrecy, so the same questions are asked as the form's own, restricted fields.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Tax (tax data read by the tax authority only); field series Part 1 §1.1 (groups are immutable)

deviations.what: The business contract's taxpayer.declaration (must_be_true) and the specification's signed attestation are carried by the field group core.declaration_signature: the approved text version, the confirmation, the signing method, the signature (restricted) and the time; its fields record the act of declaring and hold no taxpayer data
deviations.why: The specification asks for a valid signature on a versioned text; the group gives both without a second declaration format.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: library forms load in their own JSON, never a second format; field series Part 1 §1.1

deviations.what: Taxpayer types and tax types ship empty here, naming the standard expected; the specification's form in the library (taxpayer-registration-v1) carries proposed lists for the nation to review
deviations.why: Whether a nation has a given tax or taxpayer category is its law; no list is assumed.
deviations.rule: Field series Part 2 §2.6 (CivicOS must not assume that every nation has VAT …); CLAUDE.md lib/law/rules.ts rule

deviations.what: Every field of the form is restricted and marked tax secrecy (confidentiality tax), stricter than the catalogue's administrative and personal classes where it gives them; the case is restricted and read only under canReadTax() (the tax authority's officials, auditors with a purpose), every read in the access log; other institutions learn status only through the taxpayer.status exchange service
deviations.why: Tax records are confidential: a class label alone grants no access, and nothing about a taxpayer leaves the tax authority except through an approved exchange for an approved purpose.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Tax: lib/tax/ is read by the tax authority only (canReadTax(), every read in the access log); others use the taxpayer.status exchange service

deviations.what: No rate, threshold, penalty, interest, deadline, registration threshold, obligation trigger or fee is typed: each is a named nation value checked by a binding rule (recorded as not performed and a publication blocker until the nation approves it); tax types, taxpayer categories and obligations are nation lists that ship empty, naming the standard expected
deviations.why: The field series Part 2 §2.6: tax liabilities, rates, filing periods, exemptions, penalties, interest, thresholds, deadlines, retention and appeal rights come from approved national rules, never universal constants.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Government operating model: rates, bands and tariffs come only from lib/law/rules.ts; never type a statutory rate, penalty or deadline into code or seed data

deviations.what: Changing a country configuration does not generate an impact assessment of the forms and open procedure packages it touches: the publication gates re-read the rules and lists in force each time they run, and a procedure version keeps what it was approved with until a new version is approved
deviations.why: No impact-assessment record exists on the platform yet (integration register 20.11).
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md Integration register: a stand-in is listed with what connecting it for real takes

deviations.what: The seven minimisation answers per field (Part 1 §1.6) are not in the library contract: they are given with the procedure package the nation approves and recorded in the data and privacy review (a human publication gate)
deviations.why: Question 2 (the provision that authorises collection) is the nation's law; a library draft cannot answer it. No form is approved without the review.
deviations.rule: CLAUDE.md forms: publication is lib/forms/publication.ts (human approvals by different signed-in officials)

deviations.what: Each evidence item names its kind and when it is needed; the civicos.evidence-requirement.v1 record that ties it to a provision of law is made with the nation's procedure package
deviations.why: The legal basis of evidence is the nation's; until it is cited the evidence gate does not pass.

deviations.what: Scanning, OCR, USSD/SMS and offline field capture are not on the platform: a paper form is transcribed by an official and the case records that it came on paper and who transcribed it
